outline:
設計工學（Engineering Design）是一門跨學科的領域，結合工程學和設計學的原理，旨在創造功能性、美觀且實用的產品、系統和服務。其核心在於利用科學和工程知識解決實際問題，並通過創意設計滿足用戶需求。

本課程旨在培養學生設計工學的綜合能力，涵蓋從設計規劃、服務串接、配置發展、整合設計、設計驗證到工業化的設計理論與方法應用。

課程將以工學原理為基礎，從設計流程展開，對接最新的設計趨勢，如可持續設計、數位製造、物聯網、虛擬與擴增實境（VR/AR）和用戶體驗設計等技術。這些新技術正在擴展設計工學的專業範疇。課程將通過實際演練方式加深學生對這些概念的理解。

Engineering Design is an interdisciplinary field that combines principles from engineering and design to create functional, aesthetically pleasing, and practical products, systems, and services. Its core lies in using scientific and engineering knowledge to solve real-world problems and meet user needs through creative design.

This course aims to develop students' skills in design engineering, covering design planning, service integration, configuration development, integrated design, design verification, and industrial design.

The course follows engineering principles and design processes, connecting with trends like sustainable design, digital manufacturing, IoT, VR/AR, and user experience design. These technologies expand the scope of design engineering. Through practical applications, this course will deepen students' understanding of these concepts.

flexible_learning.content:
學生依期末專題進行非同步自主學習，整合設計工學、AI及數位工具，進行系統整合、設計驗證與成果深化。自主選擇適合的方法，從功能、結構、使用者體驗、製造、永續或新興科技等面向進行跨域探索與修正，並記錄設計發展歷程。

Students independently develop their final projects through asynchronous learning, integrating engineering design, AI, and digital tools for system integration, validation, and refinement. They select suitable methods to evaluate and improve their designs across function, structure, UX, manufacturing, sustainability, or emerging technologies, while documenting the design process.
flexible_learning.outcome:
完成期末設計成果及驗證歷程紀錄，呈現問題定義、設計發展、系統整合、驗證修正至最終成果的過程。以設計成果、歷程紀錄及成果分享進行成效檢核，透過同儕觀摩與反思，培養整合設計、工程與新興科技解決實際問題的能力。

Complete a final design project documenting the process from problem definition and design development to system integration, validation, refinement, and final outcome. Learning outcomes are assessed through the final design, process documentation, and project sharing, strengthening students’ ability to integrate design, engineering, and emerging technologies to solve real-world problems
flexible_learning.assessment_ratio:
占學期總成績10%，納入期末成果與心得報告40%之評量。
（最終設計成果30%＋第17／18週自主學習成果10%）

Flexible learning outcomes account for 10% of the final course grade and are included within the 30% Final Design and Reflection Report assessment.
(Final Design Outcome 20% + Weeks 17–18 Independent Learning Outcomes 10%)
